name: earthquake-atlas
description: A full-screen explorer for recent USGS earthquake observations.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && parcel build index.html --dist-dir dist --public-url ./ --no-cache
scripts.format:check: prettier --check README.md THIRD_PARTY_DATA.md docs/*.md .github/workflows/api.yml index.html wdc-usga-gov.html static/js/app.js static/js/earthquake-data.js static/scss/app.scss scripts/*.mjs playwright.config.mjs tests/*.test.mjs tests/browser/*.test.mjs tests/fixtures/*.md tests/support/*.mjs && prettier --check .parcelrc static/data/significant_month.meta.json tests/fixtures/*.geojson --parser json
scripts.test: corepack npm run format:check && corepack npm run test:unit && corepack npm run build && corepack npm run test:dist

author: Jovani Pink
